entities.name: Kirlen
entities.description: An old wizard and master of the House of Bolk in Estark, obsessed with immortality, who lost her chance at planeswalking to Kuthuman.

entities.name: House of Bolk
entities.description: One of the houses of Estark, led by Kirlen.

entities.name: Estark
entities.description: City in Kush where House Bolk stood.

entities.name: Kuthuman
entities.description: Kirlen's former lover who took her planeswalking spell and became god-like.

entities.name: Zarel
entities.description: Grand Master of the Arena who stormed House Bolk to steal the spell of planeswalking.

entities.name: Kush
entities.description: The region of Dominaria containing Estark.

events.summary: Kuthuman convinced Kirlen to give him her spark-igniting spell, promising to find enough mana for both.
events.quote: Kuthuman convinced her to give him this spell

events.summary: After destroying the House of Oor-tael Kuthuman became god-like and forgot his promise; betrayed, Kirlen stopped keeping herself young and aged quickly.
events.quote: Feeling betrayed, Kirlen stopped keeping herself young

events.summary: Zarel stormed House Bolk to steal the spell of planeswalking; Kirlen teleported away, covering the room in ice, as House Bolk fell.
events.quote: she managed to reach her private quarters and teleport away

relations.quote: the master of the House of Bolk

relations.note: They were lovers before his ascension.
